c74object.name: evi_resampling_templates
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_resampling_templates.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_resampling_templates.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_resampling_templates.genexpr file also requires:
evi_interp.genexpr
About this File:
!! This file is designed to be read, not required; these are templates for copy/pasting and testing/making your own quasi resamplers; it is not advised to 'require' this file directly !! Why: There is no native resampling in gen~, which poses a real problem. This file includes various basic cubic interpolation hacks. First are one in one out interpolators for memoryless non-linearities. Then the same for two inputs one output. Finally there are versions which can be used for nonlinear filters. Comments in the code detail how it is done.
